ask: A CRM for my deals, companies and contacts. Remind me about stale deals and draft follow-ups from Gmail, and tell #sales when a deal is won.

data.line: Deal · name, company, stage (Lead → Won/Lost), amount, close, owner
Contact · name, email, phone (hidden until revealed), title, company

automation.line: Weekdays 9:00 · deals untouched 14 days → draft a follow-up, send after you approve
Deal won → a short handoff posted to #sales after you approve

screens.line: Deals · list and board by stage, deal in the panel, bulk moves
Companies · list with each company's deals; add a company
Contacts · list, contact in the panel

agent.line: CRM agent · drafts emails, updates deals, answers pipeline questions
